text: Figure 3.5: Example: Data flow in the scope of System Timing view In addition, a timing description in system view refers to the concrete communication of software components that only was represented as abstract connectors in VfbTiming view. Due to the software mapping, now communication is either local communication over the RTE (both software components on same ECU) or remote communication over the RTE, through the communication stack of the BSW and a communication bus. A system-specific timing description thus can refer to signals (RTE), I-PDUs (COM) and frames (communication driver and bus).
